subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which user-facing WhatsApp sticker send contract should OpenClaw support before implementation proceeds?
rationale: The code can send a low-level sticker payload, but the public API choice affects message-tool semantics, media encoding policy, docs, and compatibility with normal image sends.

options.title: Add explicit sticker intent
options.body: Expose a WhatsApp `sticker` action or explicit sticker flag, require callers to opt in, and add validation/encoding behavior around that contract.

options.title: Auto-detect sticker WebP sends
options.body: Treat qualifying no-caption WebP image sends as stickers, which is convenient but can surprise users who intended a normal image attachment.

options.title: Keep helper internal for now
options.body: Leave the QA/runtime helper available but do not expose user-facing sticker sends until the channel action model is revisited.

recommendation.title: Add explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Expose a WhatsApp `sticker` action or explicit sticker flag, require callers to opt in, and add validation/encoding behavior around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and recent review context both route through the WhatsApp send/action surfaces he most recently changed.
